input.rationale: Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment) addresses only notice periods and the Termination Payment; there is no exit-assistance, data-return or deletion obligation anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "return" and "Content" surface only notice mechanics, delivery of Content to HDI, and confidentiality). This is a hosting/site-development arrangement in which HDI holds our Content and the Site's customer, user and order data (p0009, p0016, p0048), so on termination we would have no contractual right to recover our data or migrate the Site. Under the TRANSITION rule this absence is a deviation requiring an insert. The proposed new Section 4.3 after p0029 gives up to six (6) months of transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of Content and Site data in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and deletion with written certification, plus express survival (Section 10.7 at p0068 does not list Section 4). Fallback: 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 4.3 requiring HDI to provide up to six months of transition assistance, return Company Content and customer data in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certify deletion.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The termination section has no exit provisions, so we have added Section 4.3 requiring HDI to provide up to six (6) months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, return our Content and customer/order data in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and then delete and certify deletion. We can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback, but we cannot leave our data and the Site with no return or migration path on exit.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Company Data. Upon the expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date at HDI's then-current rates, including reasonable cooperation in migrating the Site, the URL and the hosting and operation thereof to the Company or its designee; (b) within thirty (30) days after the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content and all customer, user, order and other data relating to the Site or the Deerskin Products, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all such Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing. This Section 4.3 shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement.
